event.title: Investigation Reopened into Alleged 2024 Cornell Fraternity Rape Case
event.canonical_title: Investigation Reopened into Alleged 2024 Cornell Fraternity Rape Case
event.summary: Prosecutors in New York are reopening an investigation into an alleged gang rape that occurred at a Cornell University fraternity in 2024. This decision follows a civil lawsuit filed by the alleged victim against seven members of the Chi Phi fraternity, claiming she was drugged and raped at their house.
